subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and allow key-free managed web_search providers such as DuckDuckGo to be selected implicitly when no credentialed provider is available?
rationale: Current code, docs, and tests intentionally keep key-free managed providers explicit, while the issue and linked PR ask for a default provider-routing change with privacy and outbound-request implications.

options.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Keep the current provider-selection default and use diagnostics/setup guidance to tell users how to select DuckDuckGo when they want it.

options.title: Approve Keyless Fallback
options.body: Let the linked PR proceed only after aligning docs/runtime metadata and adding real cron or agent behavior proof for the new default.

options.title: Add Setup Warning Only
options.body: Do not auto-select DuckDuckGo, but add a more targeted doctor/setup warning for enabled keyless providers that are not selected.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
recommendation.body: Keep the current provider-selection default and use diagnostics/setup guidance to tell users how to select DuckDuckGo when they want it.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the policy PR that established the current explicit opt-in behavior being challenged here.
